personal-narrative-of-travels-to-the-equ: Alexander von Humboldt's great record of travel goes on — the bold survey of South America that taught the world to see nature whole. This volume bears his party through Venezuela and up the Orinoco, keen-eyed as ever. The base book of modern earth science, and grand adventure too.
the-church-and-the-empire-being-an-outli: Dudley Medley outlines the church's history from 1003 — its tangled relations with empire and state. His clear survey serves students well. A useful short history of a vast subject. Popes, emperors, and reformers cross his well-ordered stage. Students have long prized his lucid, fair-minded summary.
